_comment: Single source of truth for the dev environment. Bootstrap-DevEnv.ps1 reads this. Bump a version here, re-run the bootstrap, and commit the change.

winget.purpose: javac/java for helpers, R8/D8, apktool, jadx, Gradle
mirror and control the phone over ADB

androidSdk._note: Names use the Android CLI (android.exe) form: slash, not the legacy sdkmanager semicolon. android-36 = Android 16, the device's OS. The SDK's platform-tools are for Android Studio; the device procedure uses the pinned 37.0.1 copy in work\platform-tools.

archives.name: jadx-1.5.6.zip
archives.purpose: jadx command-line decompiler (the winget package is GUI-only)

deviceTools._note: Optional tools for the prepared device (docs/develop/instrumentation.md, docs/device/dev-setup.md). Downloaded into work/device-tools/, git-ignored. Bumping these is routine, unlike the inputs section.

downloads.name: frida-server-17.26.3-android-arm64.xz
downloads.purpose: Frida agent that runs as root on the device; the PC-side frida-tools must be the same major.minor

downloads.name: termux-app_v0.118.3+github-debug_universal.apk
downloads.purpose: Termux terminal and package manager; with proot-distro it runs a Debian userland on the device (install by hand with adb install)

downloads.name: org.fdroid.fdroid_2000053.apk
downloads.purpose: F-Droid 2.0.3, the free-software app store: apps and updates without a Google account. signerSha256 is the APK signing certificate published at https://f-droid.org/docs/Release_Channels_and_Signing_Keys/; the self-test checks it with apksigner. Install by hand with adb install.

frida._note: pip pins for work/.venv-frida: frida==version (must match the server above), frida-tools==toolsVersion

gsi._note: Google's AOSP arm64 GSI for Android 16, latest stable build; booted through DSU by dev/Install-Gsi.ps1 (docs/device/gsi.md). Not fetched by the bootstrap: the download is ~1 GB and behind Google's terms, which the script asks you to accept.
gsi.name: aosp_arm64-exp-BP4A.251205.006-14401865-2171cf0e.zip

aosp._note: Source for building your own GSI in WSL (dev/aosp/*.sh, docs/develop/aosp-build.md). The tag is the AOSP release that produced the pinned GSI binary above (BP4A.251205.006 = android-16.0.0_r4 per source.android.com/docs/setup/reference/build-numbers), so what you build matches what was validated. The lunch target is verified against `lunch` after the first sync.

inputs._note: The device procedure's exact tested inputs (docs/device/walkthrough.md, validation.md). Downloaded into work/ ($Work), which is git-ignored. Change these only when deliberately re-validating the procedure.

motorolaDriver.name: Motorola_Mobile_Drivers_64bit.msi
motorolaDriver._note: No stable direct URL; download manually from the support page. The bootstrap verifies it if present.
